description: This file defines a React component 'SuggestionList' for rendering suggestion dropdowns in a chat or input interface, including handling of results, scrolling, and positioning.

classes.name: SuggestionList
classes.description: A React component for displaying a list of suggestions with support for positioning, scrolling, and no-results handling.

methods.name: updateMaxHeight
methods.description: Calculates and sets the maximum height of the suggestion list based on window size and input height.

methods.name: scrollToItem
methods.description: Scrolls the suggestion list to ensure the specified item is visible.

methods.name: getComputedCssProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a computed CSS property value for an element.

methods.name: getTransform
methods.description: Calculates CSS transform style for positioning the suggestion box.

methods.name: renderNoResults
methods.description: Renders the 'no results' message when no suggestions match.
